description:
WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Develop responsive web applications using React and TypeScript

 - Build and maintain RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express

 - Design intuitive user interfaces for complex AI-powered memory features

 - Implement real-time features and optimize application performance

 - Work closely with designers to create pixel-perfect implementations

 - Integrate with AI/ML services and handle complex data visualization

 - Establish frontend architecture patterns and component libraries




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4+ years of full-stack development experience

 - Proficiency in React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript (ES6+)

 - Experience with Node.js and Express or similar backend frameworks

 - Strong understanding of database design and SQL

 - Knowledge of responsive design and CSS frameworks (Tailwind, styled-components)

 - Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines

 - Understanding of web performance optimization and accessibility

 - Strong communication and collaboration skills




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with AI/ML model integration and data visualization

 - Knowledge of GraphQL and modern API patterns

 - Experience with real-time technologies (WebSockets, WebRTC)

 - Background in SaaS product development

 - Experience with testing frameworks (Jest, Cypress, Playwright)

 - Knowledge of mobile development (React Native)

 - Experience with state management libraries (Redux, Zustand)
